content: Standard per-user RLS pattern for a profiles table keyed by auth user id: enable RLS, then policies like CREATE POLICY select_own ON profiles FOR SELECT TO authenticated USING ((select auth.uid()) = id); and equivalent INSERT WITH CHECK / UPDATE USING+WITH CHECK clauses, all comparing auth.uid() to the row's id/user_id column. Wrapping auth.uid() in (select ...) lets Postgres cache it per-statement instead of per-row (perf). Index the id/user_id column comparison side (primary key already is). Always specify TO authenticated (not public) so anon/service-role scoping is explicit.
